//@version=6
indicator("V54 vwap-source-actual-volume-hole-state", calc_bars_count=32)
var int sample = 0
anchor = sample == 0 or sample == 16
source = sample == 10 ? float(na) : close
value = ta.vwap(source, anchor)
cleanValue = ta.vwap(close, anchor)
plot(source, "INPUT_SOURCE")
plot(close, "FINITE_SOURCE_CONTROL")
plot(volume, "INPUT_VOLUME")
plot(na(source) ? 1 : 0, "SOURCE_NA")
plot(na(volume) ? 1 : 0, "ACTUAL_VOLUME_MISSING")
plot(anchor ? 1 : 0, "EXPLICIT_ANCHOR")
plot(not na(source) and not na(volume) and (na(source[1]) or na(volume[1])) ? 1 : 0, "FINITE_RECOVERY")
plot(value, "VWAP_SOURCE_HOLE")
plot(na(value) ? 1 : 0, "VWAP_SOURCE_HOLE_NA")
plot(nz(value, 123456.0), "VWAP_SOURCE_HOLE_NZ_SENTINEL")
plot(cleanValue, "VWAP_SOURCE_CONTROL")
plot(na(cleanValue) ? 1 : 0, "VWAP_SOURCE_CONTROL_NA")
plot(nz(cleanValue, 123456.0), "VWAP_SOURCE_CONTROL_NZ_SENTINEL")
plot(sample, "SAMPLE_INDEX")
plot(bar_index, "SOURCE_INDEX")
plot(time, "SOURCE_TIME")
sample += 1
